intro: From sofa to sleep, effortlessly. The Indulge sofabed blends comfort and cool style with smart adjustability—perfect for small spaces and spontaneous sleepovers.

features.title: From sit to snooze
features.text: With a simple click-clack mechanism, your sofa transforms into a cozy bed—smooth, quiet, and easy for anyone to handle.

features.title: Adjusts to your mood
features.text: Both backrest and armrests adjust in three positions, so you can lounge, recline, or lie flat just the way you like it.

features.title: Soft, sink-in comfort
features.text: Layers of soft foam and fiber padding offer a cozy seat and an even comfier bed—perfect for long movie nights or midday naps.

features.title: Strong from the inside out
features.text: The pinewood frame is knot-free and termite-resistant, giving your sofa lasting durability and strength.

features.title: Cool and comfortable
features.text: Upholstered in fab leather (microfiber), the touchpoints stay cool, breathable, and easy to maintain.

features.title: Stylishly elevated
features.text: Sturdy black powder-coated metal legs not only look sleek but also keep the design light, airy, and easy to clean around.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Indulge Leather Convertible Sofa Cum Bed
